_readme: Approved source registry for the Sanatana Dharma & Telugu Culture collector.
Section 17 is explicit about what must NOT be monitored: agriculture,
education, coaching, jobs, careers, kids learning, competitive exams and
generic study sites. None of those appear here, and the category tree in
lib/resources/taxonomy.ts has no key for them either — so a resource cannot
be filed under one even if a source served it.
Every licenseStatus below was decided by reading that site's own copyright,
terms or licence page on 31 Aug 2026. licenseNote holds the sentence that
decides it; licenseUrl holds where it was found. Only 'yes' sources are ever
downloaded and re-hosted, and exactly one source in this registry is 'yes'.
method:'manual' means the collector never fetches it, even when active.
Three reasons appear here: the site's robots.txt refuses our crawler by name
(sacred-texts, annamayya.org), its terms forbid scraping, or it serves
nothing readable to a fetcher. Those are decisions to respect, not to route
around. Such sources exist so the Learning pages can link to them.
autoPublish is false everywhere. Scripture that nobody has read must not
appear on a village temple's website.

sources.name: Telugu Wikisource
sources.licenseNote: Wikisource hosts only public-domain or freely-licensed source texts; page text is CC BY-SA 4.0 under the Wikimedia Terms of Use. Attribution, a licence link, an indication of modifications, and share-alike on any derivative are all required.
sources.attribution: Source: Telugu Wikisource (te.wikisource.org). Licensed CC BY-SA 4.0.
sources.notes: The ONLY source in this registry that both grants a free licence and holds real Telugu-language scripture — Potana's Bhagavatam, Andhra Vishnu Puranam, Bhagavad Gita, Vishnu Sahasranama. ⚠️ Wikisource hosting something is NOT proof it is public domain: it carries Sri Sri's Maha Prasthanam in full, which is protected in India until 2044. It can only pass on rights it holds. Always check the author's death year before reusing. ShareAlike is viral — a page embedding this text must itself be CC BY-SA 4.0.

sources.name: Tirumala Tirupati Devasthanams (TTD)
sources.licenseNote: 'Copyright © 2015-2026 Tirumala Tirupati Devasthanams(TTD), All Rights Reserved.' Free to read is not free to republish, and TTD enforces — it has moved against a film crew for remixing the Govinda Namavali.
sources.notes: About 4,000 titles, mostly Telugu — by far the best catalogue for this audience, and free to read at ebooks.tirumala.org. Link-only. Their robots.txt binds Googlebot only and blocks /Documents/. Writing to TTD Publications for permission is the single highest-value action available here: a village community site with an educational purpose is a sympathetic applicant, and free distribution is TTD's own mission.

sources.name: Andhra Bharati
sources.licenseNote: No copyright notice, terms page or reuse statement exists anywhere on the site. Its robots.txt permits all crawling with a 1-second delay, but crawl permission is not redistribution permission.
sources.notes: Holds the Kavitraya Andhra Mahabharatam (all 18 parvas), Potana's Bhagavatam (all 12 skandhas) and Molla's Ramayanam in full Telugu verse. ⚠️ It mixes public-domain classics with authors still in copyright — Viswanatha Satyanarayana (d. 1976), Rayaprolu Subba Rao (d. 1984), Puttaparthi Narayanacharyulu (d. 1990) — with no labelling at all. The poets are free; this digital edition is not licensed. Link, never copy. Some deep pages return 403 to non-browser agents.

sources.name: sanskritdocuments.org
sources.licenseNote: Copying is permitted 'for personal studies, to learn, and to teach', but explicitly not to 'promote your own web-site, commercial or not' or to 'get more traffic for your site'. A village site republishing to draw its own readers falls inside that prohibition. 'Let us first know what you want and what you are using it for.'
sources.notes: One of only two working feeds in this registry. Note its 'Telugu' section is Sanskrit rendered in Telugu SCRIPT, not Telugu translation — useful to someone who reads the script and knows Sanskrit, not to a Telugu reader who does not. Link-only, and permission is available on request.

sources.name: Bhagavad Gita Supersite (IIT Kanpur)
sources.licenseNote: No terms page, no licence statement and no robots.txt could be read — the site is a JavaScript application whose every route returns the same shell. Silence is not permission.
sources.notes: MANUAL — nothing is in the served HTML to read. Worth linking: it carries the Gita, Brahma Sutra and Yoga Sutra with Sanskrit commentaries. Note its eleven 'languages' are SCRIPTS; the translations are Hindi and English only, so it does not serve a Telugu reader the way its language list suggests. Funded by the Ministry of Information Technology — which does not make it public domain.

sources.name: SVBC TTD — Sri Venkateswara Bhakthi Channel
sources.licenseNote: Embedding via YouTube's own iframe player is one of the access routes YouTube's terms authorise. Downloading is not: 'You shall not download any Content unless you see a download or similar link displayed by YouTube.'
sources.notes: TTD's devotional channel — Suprabhatam, Annamayya keerthanas, temple broadcasts. Embed only, never download. Our player must honour YouTube's Required Minimum Functionality: at least 200x200, no playback before the player is visible, no overlays in front of it, no modifications. ⚠️ Neither tirumala.org nor svbcttd.com links to this YouTube channel, so its official status is strongly implied but not confirmed in writing.

sources.name: Internet Archive — Telugu books
sources.licenseNote: 'The Internet Archive does not make guarantees as to the copyright status of items on archive.org and cannot guarantee information posted on item details.' Users must ensure their own use 'is non-infringing and in accordance with all applicable laws'.
sources.attribution: Via the Internet Archive — rights per item
sources.notes: A hosting platform, not a rights clearinghouse. 14,000+ Telugu items, but most scans in the Universal Library collection are of editions published 1948-2007 and are in copyright at the edition level. Redistribute an item only when its own page shows an explicit CC or public-domain licence, OR the author died 1965 or earlier. A free download button is evidence of nothing. Everything from here lands at needs-review by design.

sources.name: Annamacharya Bhavana Vahini
sources.licenseNote: '© 2026 Annamacharya Bhavana Vahini. All Rights Reserved.' Its robots.txt also serves Disallow: / to our crawler by name, alongside a Cloudflare content-signals preamble expressly reserving rights.
sources.notes: MANUAL, and it must stay manual — this site refuses our crawler by name, which is a decision to honour rather than work around. Founded 1983, led by Dr. Shobha Raju; a credible institution and a plausible grantor if asked. The keerthana TEXTS are Annamayya's (d. 1503) and free wherever they are sourced from a public-domain edition.

sources.name: sacred-texts.com
sources.licenseNote: Split position: the underlying texts may be redistributable where they were 'originally printed in the US' and are old enough, but the site's own indexes, graphics and introductions 'may not be reproduced in any form without the permission of the copyright holder'. Its terms also cap robots at one text daily and forbid bulk downloading.
sources.notes: MANUAL — its robots.txt serves Disallow: / to our crawler by name. Little use here regardless: no Telugu content, and the reuse permission is limited to works originally printed in the US, which excludes most Indological translations. Listed so the source position is recorded rather than rediscovered.

sources.name: Vedabase (Bhaktivedanta Book Trust)
sources.licenseNote: 'Content used with permission of © The Bhaktivedanta Book Trust International, Inc. All rights reserved.'
sources.notes: MANUAL. Fully copyrighted — never quote a verse, a translation or a purport. English only; no Telugu. Listed because it is widely linked and someone will otherwise assume it is free.

sources.name: National Portal of India
sources.licenseNote: No reuse grant recorded. The Learning pages link to official citizen services; they do not copy them.
sources.notes: MANUAL — §16 says to keep official government resources as links only and never to copy a government website or make a third-party site look official. The village's existing /government/ directory already carries the vetted citizen-service links (MeeSeva, Aadhaar, DigiLocker, passport, voter, revenue), so this entry exists to record the source position, not to collect from it.

sources.name: Government of Andhra Pradesh
sources.licenseNote: No reuse grant recorded. Linked, not copied.
sources.notes: MANUAL, as above. The /government/ directory is the place these are surfaced.
